meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: Claude 在构建或改动界面后,会主动做一次视觉质检:截取网页或终端画面,用脚本对比参考图,再派两个只读助手分别检查设计系统/功能与文字显示(含中文日文韩文)是否正常,最后给出合格或不合格的结论。
howto.when: 在构建或修改任何界面后会自动触发;当你提到“视觉质检”“截图对比”等关键词,或说界面看起来不对(UI looks wrong)时也会触发。

say.text: 检查这个页面和设计稿是否一致。
say.note: 会截屏对比并给出合格与不合格清单。

say.text: 看看这里的中日韩文字有没有被截断或错位。
say.note: 会做CJK文本裁切/对齐检查。

say.text: 终端界面的边框好像没对齐,帮我看看。
say.note: 会捕获终端画面并检查边框对齐。

howto.what_en: After building or changing any UI, Claude performs a visual QA pass: captures web or terminal screenshots, runs bundled diff scripts, dispatches two read-only reviewers (design-system/functional and visual/CJK checks), and produces a good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically after building or changing any UI, or when you ask whether a page/component/TUI looks right. Also triggered by keywords such as visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, etc.

say_en.text: Check if this page matches the design mockup.
say_en.note: Captures and diffs it, then returns a pass/fail list.

say_en.text: Check whether the CJK text here is clipped or misaligned.
My terminal borders look misaligned, please check.
say_en.note: Captures the TUI and checks border alignment.
